dialogues.speaker: Debal
dialogues.text: Of course, I have my own business to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Debal
dialogues.text: I run a perfectly legitimate business here. Do you know Fonta? I know a few people who are planning to replicate it and create a unique beverage of their own.

dialogues.speaker: Debal
dialogues.text: Once they've perfected the recipe, I'll facilitate getting the drink into the port for people to sample, and then handle the additional promotion.
